name: Yale (Connecticut hardwood hills, high summer)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours), same keys as pnw.json. Yale Golf Course, New Haven CT: Raynor's 1926 course cut through a rocky, steep, deep-green hardwood forest (oak, maple, hickory, beech, with white pine and hemlock). Made from seekonk (course chat, 2026-10-31): the turf a shade cooler and deeper, a darker rough (the woods' shade), tan-gold fescue tones for native grass, white sand, still grey-green ponds, grey ledge in the K tones. Trees in assets-src/trees_yale.py. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
